description: Spatial coverage is the Dunvegan project site and the affected Peace River reach. The Alberta assessment catalogue documents modelling for Glacier Power’s proposed 100 MW run-of-river Dunvegan hydropower project, two kilometres upstream of Dunvegan highway bridge near Fairview. The proposed works include a powerhouse, weir, headpond and power line. The metadata says the assessment was deemed complete in 2008. Its technical-report descriptors explicitly identify numerical and physical model studies, two-dimensional numerical modelling of a 100-year flood event and construction sequences, fishway hydraulic models, sediment transport and Peace River ice-regime effects. This establishes a documented simulation application to a specific proposed infrastructure design. Numerical results, model equations and software identities remain unverified. The listing is predominantly PDF, with one XLS component; all remain linked under the project package. No construction or present operating claim is made. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue provides descriptive metadata and exact original Alberta distribution identifiers. It labels the collection Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is through the linked descriptive record; current provider access and actual file downloads are untested. Costs are not stated. No document, workbook, archive or dataset body was fetched, and numerical contents have not been independently checked. Related editions and components are grouped only where the source identifies their relationship.
